snippet.title: Little Devils - Official Gameplay & Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
👾 A simple gameplay trailer for Little Devils, due out on February 29, 2024.

🚀 Don't miss out on the adventure of a lifetime! Wishlist Little Devils now on Steam and be among the first to explore the secrets of this mesmerizing universe.

👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400060/Little_Devils/
👉 Website: https://kitjenson.com/littledevils/
